title: The Gift of Song at Dawn

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager wants to sing to their partner at dawn on their wedding day: sing it, or write it on bark.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: On Isola, there is an old custom: on the morning of a wedding, one partner sings to the other at dawn. (subject) has a song ready for (friend), but (subject.his/her) voice has been hoarse for a week with a cold. The wedding is tomorrow. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: At dawn, (subject) croaks the song outside (friend)'s door. It sounds like a frog with a broken heart. (friend) comes out in tears, laughing and crying, and says it is the best thing (friend.he/she) has ever heard. Several neighbors disagree, loudly.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) carves the song on a strip of bark and leaves it at (friend)'s door at dawn. (friend) reads it in the doorway, slowly. Years later, it still hangs in their hut, the carving a little faded.
